description: NaTmCl₄ is Hydrophilite-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic P2/c space group. Na is bonded to six Cl atoms to form NaCl₆ octahedra that share corners with eight equivalent TmCl₆ octahedra and edges with two equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-53°. There are a spread of Na-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.73-2.86 Å. Tm is bonded to six Cl atoms to form TmCl₆ octahedra that share corners with eight equivalent NaCl₆ octahedra and edges with two equivalent TmCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 46-53°. There are a spread of Tm-Cl bond distances ranging from 2.51-2.70 Å. There are two inequivalent Cl sites. In the first Cl site, Cl is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na and two equivalent Tm atoms. In the second Cl site, Cl is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Tm atom.
